title: Faryad karo
body:
Faryad karo..(8)
Ye yusuf e zahra kehte hai jis waqt hume tum yaad karo
Faryad karo..(4)
Tum shaam ke ghum me rote raho tum karbobala ko yaad karo
Faryad karo..(4)
Phat jaye ye ghaibat ka parda tum maula ki imdaad karo
Faryad karo..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Is shiddat se faryad karo har saans me unki yaad aae
jaise koi baap bichad jae jaise koi beta marr jae
faryad karo rote hai bohot ghaibat ki musibat me maula
Faryad karo..(6)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Wo phool hai chaand hai narjis ka wo noor ka darya kesa hai
ankho ka qaraar aur dil ka sukoo wo yusuf e zehra kesa hai
rehta hai wo parda e ghaibat me hum dekh nahi sakte chehra
Faryad karo..(6)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Wo khoon ke aansu rote hai humlog nahi tayyar zara
girya karna hai tumko bhi jis tarha tadapte hai maula
kya haq hai warise zahra ka faryad ka haq jo hai banta
Faryad karo..(6)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Jaa di hai azadari ke liye ab unke yateem kaha jae
Har ghar se janaze kitne uthe kis tarha tadapti hai maae
Un maao ko un bachho ko mil jae sukoo mango ye dua
Faryad karo..(6)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Maula ye ghulam jo aap ke hai apne amaal pe nadim hai
majlis me jo behte hai ansu zahra ke dil ka marham hai
zahra ka waris aata hai fauran hi bicha do farshe aza
Faryad karo..(6)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Do wasta madar e ghazi ka abbas ke daste bureeda ka
qasim ke ek ek tukde ka do wasta umme farwa ka
ho jae zahoor jo maula ka har maa ko mile uska beta
Faryad karo..(6)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Beparda haram par rota hai sar nauke sina pe sarwar ka
sadiyo se rabab ye kehti hai khali hai jhoola asghar ka
zehra ke bayn ye kehte hai abhi hai husain mera pyasa
Faryad karo..(6)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Akbar ke jigar me barchi ha hai teer gale me asghar ke
zinda me sakina ro ro kar baithi hai paas abhi darr ke
jab yaad karo us zinda ko jis waqt bhi do unko pursa
Faryad karo..(6)
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Lagta hai ye sadiyo baad qamar zinda me sakina roti hai
kaano pe hai haath rakhe uske yu qabr ke andar soti hai
azaad sakina hojae aajae agar mere maula
Faryad karo..(6)
